    The reverse coherent dual on the finite right-module skeleton #

    For a finite covariant functor G, the reverse coherent dual is

    X ↦ Ext²(G, Hom(X, -)).

    Its exact-presentation calculation will recover the corresponding contravariant defect and provide the inverse half of Auslander's duality.
